{{Top|leg}}
'''Catastrophic release braces''' were a safety measure fitted to the underside of an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]. They were used to eject the core of the main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] in case of a meltdown.
